evidence: 0100 (Pharmacy acceptance source check) and 0101 (Pharmacy dispensing source check), owner decision of 2026-11-01 by D-Eminence in chat: "Fix it now" (0101 is the review of the 0100 build under the same decision; main 0080's dispensing half); unsigned until the owner signs. Both are backward compatible. WHAT CHANGES. Two existing SECURITY DEFINER trigger functions are replaced (CREATE OR REPLACE, so owner, ACL {owner only} and triggers kept), each from its 0086 text: pg_dump --schema-only of a 0099 database before and after differs only by pharmacy.validate_work_item(), pharmacy.validate_dispensing() and their two comments, and no table's row count changes but the ledger's (191 tables). 0100: pharmacy.validate_work_item() (BEFORE INSERT on pharmacy.work_items), only the same-facility branch changed and two declarations added (stored body 58 lines added, none removed; the order-route branch, 2394 characters, and the existing same-facility checks to the end, 956 characters, byte-identical). For order_route_id null, in this order: the ehr.prescriptions row with id new.source_ehr_prescription_id is read FOR SHARE (held to commit) and must exist (23514 PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND); its status must be 'active' (23514 PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_NOT_ACTIVE); its row_version must equal new.source_ehr_prescription_version (23514 PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_VERSION_MISMATCH); patient_id, facility_id (= facility_id and ordering_facility_id), encounter_id, medication code system, code and display, dose quantity and unit, route, frequency, instructions, starts_on, ends_on, created_by (prescribed_by) and created_at (prescribed_at) must equal the work item's (23514 PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_MISMATCH): texts as stored or with the 25 characters JavaScript's trim() removes cut from the stored text, the dose by numeric value, prescribed_at as stored or cut to the millisecond, ids and dates exactly; then 0077's and 0086's checks as before (23514 PRESCRIPTION_ROUTED among them). Body md5 e2411539ee8c95a02dad46c03e24db05 (the build's 8fb2944d... less the migration number in one comment line, so renumbering cannot change the body). 0101: pharmacy.validate_dispensing() (BEFORE INSERT on pharmacy.dispensings), one declaration and one block added after its existing checks (stored body 21 lines added, none removed; the order-route branch, 411 characters, and 0077's actor and work-item check, 923 characters, byte-identical and still first). For a work item with order_route_id null, the ehr.prescriptions row it names is read FOR SHARE (held to commit) and the dispensing is refused with 23514 PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_NOT_DISPENSABLE when it is missing, or its patient_id, facility_id or encounter_id is not the work item's, or its status is not 'active', or its row_version is not source_ehr_prescription_version. Body md5 17f7e8897bd2ab240332e4d2c9f757b7. pharmacy.validate_dispensing_reversal() is unchanged (a dispensing recorded while the prescription was active can still be reversed after it is cancelled). Owner decision this carries (as on main): once its prescription changed or stopped, a same-facility work item can be neither dispensed nor accepted again (one work item per prescription); the prescriber writes a new prescription. Both read as the function owner, so under production's forced row-level security only a prescription the session may read and update is found. Signatures, plpgsql, SECURITY DEFINER, VOLATILE, not STRICT and search_path pharmacy, platform, pg_temp unchanged; ehr.prescriptions schema-qualified. runtime-grants.sql gains a 0100 and a 0101 block, each revoking its function from PUBLIC (neither had EXECUTE for anyone but its owner); no other grant, table, column, index, constraint, policy, role or permission changes; existing work items and dispensings are not touched (INSERT triggers; both tables insert-only). SERVICES (same release). pharmacy-api maps 0100's four messages to 404, 409, 409 and 422 with their own codes and 0101's message, for same-facility work only, to 409 PHARMACY_PRESCRIPTION_NOT_DISPENSABLE (the code the website already handles); any other 23514 passes on and 40001 goes to its retry. ehr-api: OrderRoutesService.send runs SERIALIZABLE (ClinicalRepository.run passes transaction options; DatabaseService.withTransaction runs a SERIALIZABLE transaction PostgreSQL cancels with 40001 or 40P01 again, up to 12 attempts, as pharmacy-api does), because a route send that commits after an acceptance's snapshot was invisible to its PRESCRIPTION_ROUTED check (also before 0100; 0100's FOR SHARE only made the acceptance wait): with the send SERIALIZABLE the overlapping acceptance fails 40001 and pharmacy-api's retry answers PRESCRIPTION_ROUTED (two sessions, the route committed after the acceptance's snapshot and the send holding the prescription while the acceptance waited; with today's READ COMMITTED send both end with a live route and a work item). The send's limits stay exact (two overlapping SERIALIZABLE sends: one cancelled, its retry counts the other); only an older image's READ COMMITTED send overlapping a new one during the rollout can pass a daily limit by one. acceptForPharmacy sends starts_on and ends_on as calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD), so 0100's exact date comparison holds whatever TZ the EHR API runs in (jest under Africa/Lagos and six other zones). OLD IMAGES on this schema: today's (82f52b9) EHR hand-off, pharmacy-api DTO, pipe options, session, acceptance and dispensing SQL, taken from 82f52b9 at run time with the real node_modules, on the upgraded database and on a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS owner's: nine legitimate acceptances pass under TZ=UTC (under Africa/Lagos today's hand-off sends local-midnight dates and the four dated ones are refused as mismatches; this release's hand-off accepts all nine under both), a changed dose, changed instructions and another version are refused, today's dispensing of a legitimate acceptance passes, and one after the prescription is cancelled, held or changed is refused 23514 PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_NOT_DISPENSABLE (answered 500 by today's image until the new one maps it). PRECONDITIONS (catalog reads only; 55000 or 42501 with nothing applied). 0100: 0001-0099 applied (0099's function the marker); not applied yet; the md5 of validate_work_item bc7df9aadfcc5f99965bcba0cfb2a5d7, platform.current_facility_id c4a7c2989e83d9cedbf1f7b785a5aaed, current_account_id b715ffe72856836d13ab16656fa6e94a, current_membership_id 641989704fea95f885fbc38c6feb5aa5, ehr.context_allows 75016690184a80bd246c365b4d108082, identity.has_active_consent_grant 8b12ce866ee75cce411a2721795ffb92; the function's attributes and trigger; the two ehr.prescriptions policies a FOR SHARE read applies and no restrictive one; the types and NOT NULLs of the 40 columns read; a UTF8 database; the applier is the owner or a member that inherits it and may SET ROLE to it; the owner's schema, SELECT, UPDATE and EXECUTE privileges, never through a superuser's bypass. 0101: 0001-0100 applied (0100's body md5 the marker); not applied yet; the md5 of validate_dispensing 23d9b6a9a9d09b106f685679df84f74f, validate_dispensing_reversal a8b1147f356e669fe0d14bea3e7ab014 and the same five session and consent functions; the function's attributes and trigger; the same policies; the types and NOT NULLs of the 14 columns read; the same ownership and privilege rules. Post-checks pin each body, its attributes, its trigger and its owner-only ACL (0101 also the reversal guard). LOCKS, measured with pg_locks before commit: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE on each function (its comment), ACCESS SHARE on schema pharmacy and the language, ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on the session's own temporary schema; no application table lock held to commit. Behind ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on ehr.prescriptions (both) or pharmacy.work_items (0101) the runner stopped after its 5 s lock timeout (5.2-5.3 s), nothing applied, and applied once the holder ended; behind ROW EXCLUSIVE on ehr.prescriptions, pharmacy.work_items or pharmacy.dispensings, or ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on pharmacy.dispensings, it applied in 0.2-0.4 s; writes took their locks with NOWAIT while the transaction was open. Apply time 25 ms and 11 ms (the runner's execution_ms). At run time, with two sessions on both owners: an acceptance or a dispensing holds the prescription FOR SHARE; other FOR SHARE, FOR KEY SHARE and plain reads proceed and FOR NO KEY UPDATE and FOR UPDATE wait; an acceptance or a dispensing that reaches a prescription the EHR is changing waits about 2 s and fails 40001, and pharmacy-api's retry answers PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_VERSION_MISMATCH or PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_NOT_DISPENSABLE; a dispensing whose prescription the EHR changed after its snapshot fails 40001 and its retry is refused. PROVED on throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 as pgrun: a fresh install of 0001-0101 by the runner before any runtime role existed (both functions owner-only before and after the role bootstrap); an upgrade of a 0099 database bootstrapped with 82f52b9's runtime-grants.sql (plan, dry run rolled back, apply, 0 pending after, each file applied again answers 'already applied'), after which the bootstrap with this runtime-grants.sql changed no privilege (the 1283 non-owner grants identical before and after, and to the fresh install's and the 0099 base's); all 75 database suites pass on both. A NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS owner and a member login of it each apply both (owned by the owner either way; the two new suites and the session-guard suite pass on both) and a role that is neither is refused with 42501; every suite on the reowned 0099 base and the reowned 0101 fails the same seven owner-mode suites and no other.
